user.title: Connect to Pi-hole
user.description: Configure the Pi-hole API used for presence tracking.

data.password: Pi-hole v6 web or application password

data_description.host: Pi-hole hostname, IP, or HTTP/HTTPS address, including a port or reverse proxy prefix if needed.
data_description.api_mode: Auto detect tries the Pi-hole v6 API before the legacy API.
data_description.password: Optional v6 password. Use an application password when two-factor authentication is enabled.
data_description.api_token: Optional token for the pre-v6 PHP API.
data_description.away_time: Seconds without a DNS query before a device is marked not home.
data_description.stale_device_days: Devices without a DNS query for this many days are ignored.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Pi-hole
reauth_confirm.description: Update the credentials for this Pi-hole. Existing devices and entity IDs are preserved.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS Pi-hole address without embedded credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Pi-hole web/API server. Check the host, port, certificate, and API availability; DNS can still work while the API is unavailable.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Use a Pi-hole v6 web/application password or a pre-v6 API token, as appropriate.
error.invalid_response: Pi-hole returned an unsupported, invalid, or busy API response. Check the API mode and Pi-hole web/API server.
